newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka launches major offensive against rebels.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka launches major offensive against rebels.

text.p: The Sri Lankan army has launched a major offensive against Tamil rebels in the north of the island to link two government-held strategic outposts, senior military officials said on Wednesday.

Military officials in the north of the country and in Colombo said the army launched the three-pronged offensive with air support from Vavuniya on noon Tuesday, Sri Lanka's Independence Day, and so far had encountered no resistance from the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam.
